functions._coordinator:
def _coordinator(
        self,
        window: Window,
        token: str,
        service: Any,
        request: Any,
        config: Any,
    ) -> OverflowCoordinator | None:
        from reflexio.server.services.durable_learning.user_lease import (
            adopt_agent_run_for_execution,
            create_owned_agent_run,
        )

        known = self.storage.get_agent_run(f"window:{window.window_id}")
        manifest = self._overflow_manifest(known)
        groups = service.service_config.window_interactions
        if self._requires_compatibility_execution(window, known, manifest, groups):
            return None
        if known is None:
            # Host CLIs select opaque models and do not honor max_tokens. Keep
            # their real existing adapter rather than inventing capacity/usage
            # guarantees. Saved protocol work must never switch adapters.
            try:
                agent_models = self.client.get_completion_model_ladder(
                    model_role=ModelRole.EXTRACTION_AGENT
                )
            except ModelRoleUnavailableError:
                # This provider cohort cannot run the coordinator's agent
                # stages. Preserve its established adapter rather than invent
                # a model fallback or fail before an ordinary negative gate.
                return None
            models = (
                *self.client.get_completion_model_ladder(),
                *self.client.get_completion_model_ladder(
                    model=service._resolve_should_run_model()
                ),
                *agent_models,
            )
            if any(
                model.partition("/")[0] in {"local-cli", "openclaw"} for model in models
            ):
                return None
        # The coordinator owns eligible native text work. Existing CLI, image,
        # mock and saved-state contracts retain their compatibility adapters.
        prepared, chunk_tokens, preparation_version = self._prepare_coordinator_sources(
            groups, window.user_id, known, manifest
        )
        if not prepared.chunks:
            if manifest is not None:
                raise ExtractionInputIntegrityError(
                    "Prepared extraction lost textual evidence"
                )
            # Image-only requests use the established multimodal extractor.
            # Empty text coverage must never become an all-false chunk vote.
            return None
        if (
            manifest is not None
            and manifest.get("source_digest") != prepared.source_digest
        ):
            raise WindowInputsDeletedError(
                "Extraction source changed after preparation"
            )
        if manifest is not None and manifest.get("chunk_digests") != [
            OverflowCoordinator.candidate_key(chunk.text) for chunk in prepared.chunks
        ]:
            raise ExtractionInputIntegrityError("Admitted extraction partition changed")
        replan = manifest.get("checkpoint", {}).get("repartition") if manifest else None
        if replan is not None:
            prepared = repartition_extraction_input(
                prepared,
                chunk_index=replan["chunk_index"],
                split_after=replan["split_after"],
            )
            if replan.get("chunk_digests") != [
                OverflowCoordinator.candidate_key(chunk.text)
                for chunk in prepared.chunks
            ]:
                raise ExtractionInputIntegrityError(
                    "Frozen extraction repartition changed"
                )
        expected_run = build_extractor_agent_run_record(
            org_id=self.context.org_id,
            extractor_kind=window.kind,
            user_id=window.user_id,
            generation_request_id=request.request_id,
            agent_version=getattr(request, "agent_version", None),
            source=request.source,
            request_interaction_data_models=groups,
            extractor_config=config,
            service_config=service.service_config,
            agent_context=(known.agent_context_snapshot or "")
            if known is not None
            else self.context.configurator.get_agent_context(),
        )
        if known is not None and not matches_frozen_window_binding(
            known,
            expected_run,
            window.policy["extractor"],
            project_id=window.project_id,
        ):
            raise ExtractionInputIntegrityError(
                "Extraction coordinator parent binding changed"
            )
        if manifest is None:
            manifest = OverflowCoordinator.initial_manifest(prepared.source_digest)
            manifest["input_chunk_tokens"] = chunk_tokens
            manifest["preparation_version"] = preparation_version
            manifest["chunk_digests"] = [
                OverflowCoordinator.candidate_key(chunk.text)
                for chunk in prepared.chunks
            ]
            run = replace(expected_run, id=f"window:{window.window_id}")
            run.generation_request_snapshot["overflow"] = manifest
            if window.kind == "profile":
                from reflexio.server.services.durable_learning.ordinary_profile_preparation import (
                    KEY,
                    ordinary_profile_preparation,
                )

                # Unsupported layouts/adapters retain ordinary execution but
                # acquire no selective continuation authority. Capture outside
                # the short owner transaction and before any provider call.
                with suppress(
                    OSError, ValueError, TypeError, InputBudgetConfigurationError
                ):
                    run.generation_request_snapshot[KEY] = ordinary_profile_preparation(
                        self, window, service, config
                    )
            with self.storage.commit_scope():
                self.storage.fence_user_extraction(window.user_id, token)
                self.storage.validate_extraction_source_digest(
                    window, prepared.source_digest
                )
                known = create_owned_agent_run(self.storage, run)
        elif known is not None:
            with self.storage.commit_scope():
                self.storage.fence_user_extraction(window.user_id, token)
                self.storage.validate_extraction_source_digest(
                    window, prepared.source_digest
                )
                known = adopt_agent_run_for_execution(self.storage, known)
        if known is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Extraction coordinator parent is unavailable")
        turn_seconds = max(240, self.client.config.timeout + 60)
        # The coordinator guards every dispatch against this absolute turn
        # deadline. Its enclosing extractor future must leave time for the last
        # admitted call to save usage/output and yield without losing ownership.
        service._window_extractor_timeout_seconds = turn_seconds + 10
        coordinator = OverflowCoordinator(
            self.storage,
            window,
            token,
            manifest,
            source_digest=prepared.source_digest,
            context_limits=declared_context_limits(
                env_str("REFLEXIO_LLM_CONTEXT_LIMITS_JSON", default="{}")
            ),
            prepared=prepared,
            agent_context=known.agent_context_snapshot or "",
            # A turn must admit at least one configured provider call. The
            # worker renews its user lease while it waits; checkpoints still
            # yield before another call can outlive the remaining turn.
            turn_seconds=turn_seconds,
        )
        coordinator.saved_run = known
        return coordinator

functions._playbook_items_from_output:
def _playbook_items_from_output(
        self,
        run: AgentRunRecord,
        extractor_config: ProfileExtractorConfig | PlaybookConfig,
        request_interaction_data_models: list[RequestInteractionDataModel],
        committed_output: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> tuple[list[Any], list[str]]:
        if not isinstance(extractor_config, PlaybookConfig):
            raise ResumeWorkerError("Expected playbook extractor config")
        user_id = run.binding.user_id
        if not user_id:
            raise ResumeWorkerError("Playbook finalization retry requires user_id")
        expert_mode = has_expert_content(
            extract_interactions_from_request_interaction_data_models(
                request_interaction_data_models
            )
        )
        strict_evidence, evidence_references = _run_playbook_contract_selection(
            self.request_context,
            run,
            expert=expert_mode,
        )
        prompt_context = build_playbook_prompt_context(
            request_interaction_data_models,
            expert=expert_mode,
            label_turns=strict_evidence,
        )
        contract = build_playbook_extraction_contract(
            self.request_context.prompt_manager,
            expert=expert_mode,
            evidence_sources=prompt_context.evidence_sources,
            evidence_units=prompt_context.evidence_units,
            strict_override=strict_evidence,
            evidence_references_override=evidence_references,
        )
        output = contract.schema.model_validate(committed_output)
        if not isinstance(
            output,
            StructuredPlaybookList
            | StructuredReferencedExtractedPlaybookList
            | StructuredExtractedPlaybookList,
        ):
            raise ResumeWorkerError(
                "Committed playbook output validated to an unexpected schema: "
                f"{type(output).__name__}"
            )
        agent_context = self.request_context.configurator.get_agent_context()
        service_config = PlaybookGenerationServiceConfig(
            request_id=run.binding.request_id,
            agent_version=run.binding.agent_version or "",
            user_id=user_id,
            source=run.binding.source,
            auto_run=False,
            force_extraction=True,
        )
        extractor = PlaybookExtractor(
            request_context=self.request_context,
            llm_client=self.client,
            extractor_config=extractor_config,
            service_config=service_config,
            agent_context=agent_context,
        )
        if contract.strict:
            items = extractor._process_structured_response_list(
                output,
                evidence_sources=prompt_context.evidence_sources,
                evidence_units=prompt_context.evidence_units,
            )
        else:
            items = extractor._process_structured_response_list(
                output,
                source_interaction_ids=list(run.binding.source_interaction_ids),
            )
        return items, run.pending_tool_call_ids
functions._run_playbook_contract_selection:
def _run_playbook_contract_selection(
    request_context: RequestContext,
    run: AgentRunRecord,
    *,
    expert: bool,
) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
    """Resolve the playbook schema selected when the durable run was created."""
    output_schema_name = run.generation_request_snapshot.get("output_schema_name")
    if output_schema_name == StructuredReferencedExtractedPlaybookList.__name__:
        return True, True
    if output_schema_name == StructuredExtractedPlaybookList.__name__:
        return True, False
    if output_schema_name == StructuredPlaybookList.__name__:
        return False, False
    # Backward compatibility for durable runs created before the schema name was
    # snapshotted. New runs never consult activation state during resume.
    strict = uses_evidence_grounded_extraction(
        request_context.prompt_manager,
        expert=expert,
    )
    return strict, strict and not expert
